item.title: New data shows Santa Monica is a Spring Break destination for families
item.description: Santa Monica sees surge in spring break family bookings from Los Angeles area, with Airbnb searches up and families making up 60% of travelers.

item.title: Residents celebrate International Women's Day with multicultural fashion show
item.description: Eight countries were represented at Santa Monica Christian Towers multicultural fashion show celebrating International Women's Day March 2024.

item.title: City of Malibu Now Accepting Grant Applications for Local Nonprofits
item.description: Malibu is accepting nonprofit grant applications for 2026-2027 funding through March 31. Grants support homelessness services, arts, youth programs, and environmental protection.

item.title: Caltrans Seeks Public Input on Lincoln Boulevard Bus Lane Extension
item.description: Caltrans seeks public input on extending bus lanes 3.1 miles on Lincoln Boulevard from Venice to Manchester Avenue in Santa Monica. Survey open until April 17.

item.title: Santa Monica College to Host Free Arts Professional Talk Series
item.description: Santa Monica College hosts free Spring 2026 arts professional talks March 13-June 5 at noon on Main Campus, featuring gallery directors and curators.

item.title: Heal the Bay Aquarium to Reopen Saturday After Flood Damage
item.description: Heal the Bay Aquarium reopens Saturday noon-4pm at Santa Monica Pier after flood damage recovery. Free community event with reservations.
